pull_request.title: Infrastructure: record PR interactions and add conversation Pages tab
pull_request.head: codex/pr-interaction-ledger
pull_request.body:
## Five-line summary

- Added separate interaction records for all 91 PRs, including this PR.
- Added a GitHub Pages Interactions tab with searchable PRs and graphical human/agent conversations.
- Recorded parties, agent/subagent roles, interaction types, source links and tool provenance.
- Linked canonical token accounts without duplicating totals and marked missing history/models explicitly.
- Added accounting synchronization rules, publication validation and CI coverage for both dashboard tabs.

## Details

Add an individual `interactions/pr-NNNN.json` for every PR, with separate journal and visible-turn evidence files. Records identify human actions, prompt and remote Codex inputs, responses, interaction types, parties, agent/subagent roles, tool provenance and canonical token-account references.

Backfill all 90 existing PRs from public discussions, canonical journals and 37 pinned branch-journal snapshots. Retain 1,052 user-visible messages from 198 exactly matched turns. Of 251 distinct referenced account turns, 53 have no available visible snapshot; gaps and unknown models/providers stay explicit. Turn collection excludes reasoning, command bodies/results, arbitrary tool arguments, private state and binary uploads. Numeric token counters stay with their original session owners; shared PR references are not allocations.

Add an Interactions tab beside Token usage in the existing GitHub Pages resource ledger. Search PRs by number, title or party; view sender-specific conversation cards, expandable long messages, source links and role/tool/account details. Recorded messages, public GitHub discussion and selected session notes remain separate source views, preserving their evidence boundaries. PR/source deep links and browser history work on desktop and mobile.

The stdlib site exporter validates every ledger and publishes a narrow index plus lazy per-PR payloads. Text remains literal rather than executable markup. The output allowlist rejects unexpected/stale files and symlinks. No frontend dependencies or external services were added. The existing workflow builds PR previews and deploys both tabs from main after merge.

Add the ongoing accounting rule and PR checklist to refresh discussion/evidence, update canonical usage, synchronize affected PR records and validate. CI requires the current PR record, rejects stale journal/account fingerprints and prevents removal of historical records against the base commit. Captures remain dated snapshots; offline checks cannot detect subsequent GitHub edits.

Tool provenance distinguishes native Codex operations, dependencies installed by Codex and instructed software such as IdRes, ACTS/Spack and unrooted. Unproven installation provenance remains unresolved.

Validation: 15 Python token/site tests and both JavaScript suites pass. Browser QA covered both tabs, PR/source navigation, history, long-message expansion and evidence disclosure. At 390 × 844 the layout has no horizontal overflow; the temporary viewport override was reset. Interaction/session/project/usage validators and the two-tab preview build pass. The earlier 14 interaction tests and 33 session/recovery tests also passed. CI reruns on the final push.

A separate fixed-revision SoftEng assessment of the ledger found two gaps; historical-deletion enforcement and standard closing-issue capture now have regression coverage. A separate explicit SoftEng assignment implemented the three owned frontend files; its contract and result are retained. Role assignment does not claim native profile loading or human approval.

Main accounting remains 234 disjoint turns / 740,993,210 observed tokens. Current parent and frontend-child turns have no completed exact counters. Infrastructure only: no detector or scientific-progress changes; ADR-004 remains DRAFT. Includes PR98's own interaction record and unobserved task accounts.

## Five-line summary

- Added separate interaction records for all 91 PRs, including this PR.
- Added a GitHub Pages Interactions tab with searchable PRs and graphical human/agent conversations.
- Recorded parties, agent/subagent roles, interaction types, source links and tool provenance.
- Linked canonical token accounts without duplicating totals and marked missing history/models explicitly.
- Added accounting synchronization rules, publication validation and CI coverage for both dashboard tabs.

## Details

Add an individual `interactions/pr-NNNN.json` for every PR, with separate journal and visible-turn evidence files. Records identify human actions, prompt and remote Codex inputs, responses, interaction types, parties, agent/subagent roles, tool provenance and canonical token-account references.

Backfill all 90 existing PRs from public discussions, canonical journals and 37 pinned branch-journal snapshots. Retain 1,052 user-visible messages from 198 exactly matched turns. Of 251 distinct referenced account turns, 53 have no available visible snapshot; gaps and unknown models/providers stay explicit. Turn collection excludes reasoning, command bodies/results, arbitrary tool arguments, private state and binary uploads. Numeric token counters stay with their original session owners; shared PR references are not allocations.

Add an Interactions tab beside Token usage in the existing GitHub Pages resource ledger. Search PRs by number, title or party; view sender-specific conversation cards, expandable long messages, source links and role/tool/account details. Recorded messages, public GitHub discussion and selected session notes remain separate source views, preserving their evidence boundaries. PR/source deep links and browser history work on desktop and mobile.

The stdlib site exporter validates every ledger and publishes a narrow index plus lazy per-PR payloads. Text remains literal rather than executable markup. The output allowlist rejects unexpected/stale files and symlinks. No frontend dependencies or external services were added. The existing workflow builds PR previews and deploys both tabs from main after merge.

Add the ongoing accounting rule and PR checklist to refresh discussion/evidence, update canonical usage, synchronize affected PR records and validate. CI requires the current PR record, rejects stale journal/account fingerprints and prevents removal of historical records against the base commit. Captures remain dated snapshots; offline checks cannot detect subsequent GitHub edits.

Tool provenance distinguishes native Codex operations, dependencies installed by Codex and instructed software such as IdRes, ACTS/Spack and unrooted. Unproven installation provenance remains unresolved.

Validation: 15 Python token/site tests and both JavaScript suites pass. Browser QA covered both tabs, PR/source navigation, history, long-message expansion and evidence disclosure. At 390 × 844 the layout has no horizontal overflow; the temporary viewport override was reset. Interaction/session/project/usage validators and the two-tab preview build pass. The earlier 14 interaction tests and 33 session/recovery tests also passed. CI reruns on the final push.

A separate fixed-revision SoftEng assessment of the ledger found two gaps; historical-deletion enforcement and standard closing-issue capture now have regression coverage. A separate explicit SoftEng assignment implemented the three owned frontend files; its contract and result are retained. Role assignment does not claim native profile loading or human approval.

Main accounting remains 234 disjoint turns / 740,993,210 observed tokens. Current parent and frontend-child turns have no completed exact counters. Infrastructure only: no detector or scientific-progress changes; ADR-004 remains DRAFT. Includes PR98's own interaction record and unobserved task accounts.

User request, exact: “Great, can we add a second tab to the GitHub deployed pages that allow to navigate through the PRs and see the interactions - it could be nicely graphical (per PR) as a conversation between humans and agent(s)”

independent file, without a shared inventory. Added standard closing-keyword
parsing and corrected a null PR body case. Two regression tests cover the
reported gaps, including all three closing-keyword families. All 13 interaction
tests pass. These remedies are coordinator changes after the review revision;
the original findings and source target remain retained.
